name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The user aims to easily find recycling facilities close to their location by searching with a zip code.
The user wants to view essential details about recycling facilities, such as operational hours and accepted materials.
The user seeks to view recycling centers, public bins, and special waste drop-off sites on an interactive map for better navigation.
The user desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events and safe disposal opportunities.
The user aims to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities and receiving tailored recommendations.
The user wants to communicate with administrators to provide feedback, ask questions, or report issues.
The administrator aims to ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current and correct.
The administrator seeks to review and act upon user feedback and complaints to improve the service.
The administrator is responsible for safeguarding all user and facility data against unauthorized access or breaches.
The administrator aims to establish and maintain direct communication channels with recycling facility representatives.
The facility representative aims to keep their facility's details, such as operational hours and accepted materials, accurate and up-to-date on the platform.
The facility representative seeks to convey any concerns or issues regarding their facility's listing or the platform to the site administrators.
lowLevelGoals: The system should enable users to enter a zip code to initiate a search for recycling facilities within that area.
Upon entering a zip code, the system should present a list of recycling facilities found in that vicinity.
The system should provide options for users to refine their search results by selecting specific types of recycling facilities.
The system should allow users to select a specific recycling facility from the displayed list to access more detailed information about it.
The system should present the opening and closing times for a chosen recycling facility.
The system should provide a clear list of materials that a specific recycling facility accepts.
The system should show relevant contact details for a chosen recycling facility.
The system should display a map interface with markers indicating the geographical positions of recycling centers.
The system should include markers for public recycling bins on the interactive map.
The system should mark locations for special waste drop-off sites on the interactive map.
The system should enable users to adjust the magnification level of the map.
The system should offer a feature to generate navigation directions to a chosen recycling facility.
The system should deliver real-time alerts to users regarding scheduled recycling events.
The system should inform users about available options for safely disposing of particular waste materials.
The system should enable users to customize their notification preferences to receive alerts relevant to their geographical area or specific recycling needs.
The system should provide a feature for users to mark and store preferred recycling facilities for quick access.
The system should suggest recycling facilities to users based on their past interactions and saved preferences.
The system should enable users to specify the types of materials they recycle to get more relevant facility recommendations.
The system should offer a dedicated form for users to send comments, suggestions, or issues to the administrators.
The system should enable users to flag and report inaccuracies in the displayed information for recycling facilities.
The system should include a resource with answers to frequently asked questions and general support information.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to input and store information about new recycling facilities.
The system should provide tools for administrators to modify and update the information of existing recycling facilities.
The system should allow administrators to delete records of recycling facilities that are no longer operational or relevant.
The system should offer a centralized interface for administrators to review all feedback, questions, and reports submitted by users.
The system should enable administrators to send replies or take action on user feedback within the application.
The system should provide a mechanism for administrators to track the status of user feedback.
The system should ensure that only authorized users can access specific features and data through secure login procedures.
The system should apply encryption to protect confidential information of users and facilities from unauthorized disclosure.
The system should perform routine backups of all data and have procedures in place to restore data in case of loss.
The system should offer a private and secure channel for administrators to exchange messages with recycling facility representatives.
The system should enable administrators to send a single message or alert to a group of recycling facility representatives simultaneously.
The system should provide a secure login for facility representatives to view and manage their specific facility's information.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the opening and closing times of their facility.
The system should allow facility representatives to add, remove, or modify the types of materials their facility accepts.
The system should offer a dedicated channel for facility representatives to report problems or ask questions to the site administrators.
The system should enable facility representatives to track whether their reported concerns have been received, are being addressed, or have been resolved by administrators.
